Easy BBQ Cilantro Lime Shrimp
By: Melissa
Published: Sunday, May 15, 2016 - 11:09pm

Ingredients




1 lb Shrimp
1/3 bunch of chopped Cilantro
Juice of 3 Limes
Zest of 1 Lime
1 Jalapeno, seeded and minced
3 Garlic Cloves, minced
¼ teaspoon Salt
¼ teaspoon Pepper
¼ teaspoon Cumin
2 tablespoons Olive Oil

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients except shrimp in a bowl 2 Peel and devein shrimp 3 Place shrimp in bowl and mix well to cover them all in marinade mixture 4 Marinate for 30 min to an hour 5 Place shrimps on skewers and BBQ over medium heat until cooked (about 3 min per side) 6 Enjoy!

About

These juicy shrimps are magical after marinating in this delicious cilantro lime garlicky marinade. HUGE flavors that will be sure to heat up your next cookout. And did I mention they clock in at less than 200 calories a serving? #Winning
